{{Quote|Captain Wankle, we found nothing out of the ordinary except several crates of Bantha Breakfast Biscuits.''"<br />"''Blue sauce?''"<br />"''Plenty, Sir!''"<br />"''Inform the men there'll be a special meal tonight!|A [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Wankle]], discussing the cargo of the ''[[Chubby Gundark]]''|<ref name="br" />}}
'''Blue sauce''' was a condiment that was often used on [[Bantha Breakfast Biscuit]]s. Blue sauce was also the only known way to destroy a [[Giant Amorphous Bantha Breakfast Biscuit]].
